creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From #153, batch 14, item 5.

`write_stash_file`, `load_stash_file` and friends keep files under `<stash>/files/`, but `get_stash_path(name)` joins `name` onto the stash root. So the path it returns for a file a script just wrote doesn't exist:

```rad
write_stash_file("x.txt", "hello")
print(get_stash_path("x.txt"))                  // <rad home>/stashes/<id>/x.txt
print(load_stash_file("x.txt", "").full_path)   // <rad home>/stashes/<id>/files/x.txt
```

Reproduces on main. No doc mentions `files/`, so a script that hands `get_stash_path` of the same name to a shell redirect silently writes or reads somewhere else. The working form is `load_stash_file(name, "").full_path`.

Decide: make `get_stash_path` resolve into `files/` (breaks anyone relying on the root, e.g. for state files), or add a way to get the files root and document in each function's docs which root it uses.

Where: `core/home_stash.go:49` `GetStashSub`, `core/funcs.go:1445` (`get_stash_path`), `docs/funcs/get_stash_path.md`.
title: get_stash_path(name) and the stash file functions resolve name against different roots
